fields.clinic_subtitle: Department of Internal Medicine · 789 Health Blvd, City, ST 12345 · (555) 030-1100
fields.chief_complaint:
Patient presents with intermittent chest tightness and shortness of breath on
exertion over the past three weeks. No prior cardiac history reported.
fields.findings:
General: Alert and oriented, in no acute distress.
Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm; soft systolic murmur at the left sternal border.
Respiratory: Clear to auscultation bilaterally; no wheezes or crackles.
ECG: Mild ST-segment changes; recommend follow-up stress testing.
fields.assessment:
1. Stage 1 hypertension — begin lifestyle modification and low-dose
    antihypertensive; recheck blood pressure in 4 weeks.
2. Exertional chest discomfort — schedule cardiac stress test and lipid panel.
3. Patient advised on warning signs requiring immediate care.
